mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening supply-side activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in real personal savings (RSAFS) indicates accommodative monetary policy and increased consumer savings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and RSAFS increases > 2% MoM
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which is a leading indicator of increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) without a corresponding decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market inefficiencies, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k MoM without UNRATE decreasing
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) coupled with a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a supply-side recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines < 1% YoY and INDPRO increases > 1% YoY
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
